title: The Paper Atlas
author: Theo Hartwell
blurb: Theo Eriksen, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
